name: Three eras of work, each owning a panel
useWhen: Work runs in three named phases with different characters, and each deserves the weight of a full-height panel.

focal.note: Measured against the eyebrow, since this template has no headline of its own — the three phase names ARE the top level.

replacesNote: Third of three sequence shapes and none substitutes for the others: seq-steps-panels-5 for stages with substance, seq-phase-columns-4 for long lists with one marked NOW, this for eras that need weight.

deviations.what: first list item printing through the description
